AP reports Hegseth set a deadline for unrestricted military use, with threats of contract loss, a supply-chain-risk label and the DPA. WaPo confirms the demand was to drop the surveillance and autonomous-weapons objections.

Hegseth's signed January 2026 memo orders an 'AI-first' force across all components and says speed wins. His SpaceX speech pushed the same priority, which fits the plain reading even though motive can't be checked.
